purpose: Invoicing for freelance translators, with per-language rate cards.
audience: Freelance translators who invoice in several currencies

content.heading: Rate cards per language pair
content.body: Store one rate per source/target pair and currency; invoices pick the right one.

content.heading: Invoice in the client's currency
content.body: Conversion date and rate are printed on the invoice.

content.heading: How it works
content.body: Create a client, add a job, send the invoice, track payment.
